- issue_comment created in `experiment-repo`#6 ("Review M1: evaluate on the sparse leaderboard matrix (missing cells)") by `experiment-repo`  > M1 is delivered: the grouped protocol now runs on the real sparse MTEB matrix. Code and results are in experiment-repo `main` (c2d1f24 plus a wording fix) and in paper-repo `dev` (4aaa293). The full account is in the "Sparse leaderboard matrix" section of `code/RESULTS.md`, with the departures in `code/DEVIATIONS.md` item 14.
  > 
  > **Conditions**
  > - **Data:** MTEB score matrices with their real missing cells (NaN), 6 subsets from 21 % to 70 % observed. `sparse_subsets.csv` lists models x tasks, density, median observed cells per model, tested models, families and organisations.
  >   - `eng_full`: English tasks seen by at least 20 models, 445 x 335, 21 % observed, median 60 cells per model, 337 models tested.
  >   - `eng_d30`, `eng_d50`, `eng_d70`: English subsets trimmed to 30, 50 and 70 % observed. Sizes are 332x295, 268x176 and 226x134, with 215-332 models tested.
  >   - `all_d30`, `all_d50`: all tasks, trimmed to 30 and 50 %. Sizes are 331x705 and 236x517, with median 181 and 308 cells per model.
  > - **Split and test models:** grouped 10-fold, held out by model family. A model is tested if it has at least 30 observed cells. Training columns need at least 10 observed training cells and are standardised on their observed cells. Identity transform only.
  > - **Candidates and targets:** for each tested model and each of 3 partitions, the targets T are a random 30 % of its observed cells and the candidates C are the rest of its observed cells.
  > - **Selectors:** greedy A runs on the masked-EM factor-model covariance. Random uses 30 draws per k.
  > - **Predictors:**
  >   - `colmean`.
  >   - `fa`: masked-EM factor model, rank chosen by inner 5-fold masked marginal likelihood with the one-SE rule.
  >   - `pw`: pairwise-complete correlation, PSD-clipped and shrunk toward the identity.
  >   - `softimpute`: masked Soft-Impute fold-in.
  >   - `fa` and `pw` are the two best predictors that handle missing cells.
  > - **LOBO analogue:** all of C predicts T, using `fa` and `pw`; the reference is the lower of the two (`lobo` rows in `sparse_refs.csv`). Closure is therefore not capped at 1.
  > - **Grid:** k = 1..6, 8, 10, 12, 15, 20. There is no k=30, because C holds at most 70 % of a model's 30-100 observed cells.
  > - **Intervals:** family-clustered bootstrap, B=2000, seed 0. A k* that is never reached on the grid is censored.
  > 
  > **Results** (CIs are in the CSVs)
  > - Greedy A beats random at every k on every subset, for both `fa` and `pw`. The gap CI excludes 0 in every cell except `pw` at k=20 on `eng_full`, where it is [-0.105, 0.005].
  > - At k=3 with `fa`, the relative gap to random is 6-7 % on the English subsets, 14 % on `all_d30` and 24 % on `all_d50`.
  > - Closure at k=3, greedy A (`fa` / `pw`):
  > 
  > | Subset | `fa` | `pw` |
  > |---|---|---|
  > | `eng_full` | 0.76 | 0.79 |
  > | `eng_d30` | 0.79 | 0.79 |
  > | `eng_d50` | 0.78 | 0.78 |
  > | `eng_d70` | 0.80 | 0.80 |
  > | `all_d30` | 0.75 | 0.78 |
  > | `all_d50` | 0.72 | 0.71 |
  > 
  > - Random selection at k=3 with `pw` reaches closure 0.55-0.74.
  > - k*(0.9) with greedy A and `pw` is 6, 8, 12, 8, 10 and 20 for `eng_full`, `eng_d30`, `eng_d50`, `eng_d70`, `all_d30` and `all_d50`.
  > - Random with `fa` never reaches 0.9 on the grid on any subset. Random with `pw` is 20 on `eng_full` and `eng_d50`, 15 on `eng_d70`, and censored on the others.
  > - The k* intervals are wide, for example [3, >20] on `eng_full`. Do not report a k* value without its interval.
  > - `fa` is best or tied at k up to 5, and `pw` is slightly better at k=8 or more. Both are far better than `colmean`. `softimpute` is only slightly better than `colmean`, because its fold-in shrinks cells it cannot see.
  > - **Claim for the main text:** greedy A beats random on the sparse matrix at every density from 21 % to 70 %, with closure about 0.7-0.8 at k=3. The two supporting results are the gap CI at k=3 and closure at k=3 with greedy A against random under `pw`. k*(0.9) is secondary because of the intervals.
  > 
  > **Caveats**
  > - Identity transform only, and no density below 21 %. Models with fewer than 30 observed cells are not test
